Putting the pieces together: from zero to a service that exchanges data with TAK clients through a Deploy App TAK Server.

The sequence

1. ENROLL (once)         Deploy App / RASENMAEHER
   invite code ─▶ enrollment/init ─▶ admin accept

2. GET A CERTIFICATE     RASENMAEHER signs your CSR
   generate keypair+CSR ─▶ product/sign_csr ─▶ client cert + CA chain

3. GET GROUPS            Keycloak (admin)
   place your identity in the right tak groups (In / Out / Both)

4. CONNECT TO TAK SERVER using the mTLS cert
   ├─ CoT stream (TLS) ──▶ live events for groups you read
   └─ Marti API (/Marti/api) ──▶ missions, files, subscriptions

5. EXCHANGE DATA
   read:  subscriptions + GET missions/contents (by hash)
   write: send CoT + PUT mission contents / upload to Enterprise Sync

Walkthrough

  1. Enroll with Deploy App. Use an invite/verification code to POST /api/v1/enrollment/init; an admin approves you (POST /api/v1/enrollment/accept). See Enrolling & getting a client certificate.
  2. Get your client certificate. Generate a key pair + CSR, call POST /api/v1/product/sign_csr, and keep the returned certificate + CA chain. This is your TAK identity.
  3. Get your groups right (Keycloak). In kc.<your-server>, put your identity in the tak groups it needs — In (_WRITE) for groups you publish to, Out (_READ) for groups you ingest, Both for a two-way relay. See Keycloak: identity & groups.
  4. Connect to TAK Server with the cert.
    • For live data, open the TLS CoT stream and subscribe — you'll receive the traffic for your read groups, and CoT you emit fans out to your write groups.
    • For stored data, call the Marti API at /Marti/api/… presenting the same client certificate.
  5. Read and write.
    • Read: manage subscriptions, and GET missions + their contents, fetching files from Enterprise Sync by hash.
    • Write: send CoT, PUT mission contents / add a mission package, and upload files to Enterprise Sync.

A few practical notes

  • One identity, everywhere. The same cert reaches TAK Server and Keycloak and any other Deploy App product — and revocation in Deploy App cuts all of them at once.
  • Match the spec version. Develop against the spec version that matches the target server (this guide tracks 5.6-RELEASE-14).
  • If data "disappears," check groups before code. Most "it connected but nothing happens" issues are group direction (In vs Out), not the API call.
  • Renew before you expire. Use product/renew_csr; an expired cert drops both the CoT stream and Marti API access.
